verdict.rationale: HumanLayer runs coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) through workflows like Oneshot and RPI, and can open draft PRs, so this story is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows the agent generating or running tests to validate its changes before proposing them. The workflow-phase and draft-PR docs cover review points and PR creation, not test-based self-validation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically generate and run tests to validate its own code changes before proposing them
